# USL Odoo Distribution

> User guide and decision records for the USL Odoo distribution. Pages carry
> front matter (title, type, description, lang, persona, journey, source,
> generated) that says what each one is for and whether a test proves it.

Paths are relative to the repository root. In a running product the guide is
served at `/usl/user-docs/<path under docs/users>`; add `?format=md` or send
`Accept: text/markdown` to read the committed Markdown.

## Tutorial

- [Take a guided tour of Accounting](docs/users/TUTORIAL.md): Walk through Overview, journals, documents, reconciliation, reports, hygiene and declarations without changing posted accounting.

## How-to guides

- [Activate, monitor or pause electronic-invoice reception in production](docs/users/how-to/activate-electronic-invoice-reception.md): Switch the approved reception platform on, watch the first invoices arrive, and pause it safely.
- [Analyze analytic performance](docs/users/how-to/analyze-analytic-performance.md): Read margin and cost by activity, brand or project from the analytic analysis report.
- [Create and collect a customer invoice](docs/users/how-to/process-customer-invoice.md): Issue an invoice, send it, register the payment and confirm it is matched.
- [Enregistrer et rapprocher la paie TESE](docs/users/how-to/paie-tese.md): Saisir le bulletin calculé par TESE, joindre les justificatifs et suivre les dettes jusqu'au règlement.
- [Export reports and the FEC](docs/users/how-to/export-reports-and-fec.md): Download a report as PDF or XLSX with its current filters, and produce the annual FEC file.
- [Generate official documents](docs/users/how-to/official-documents.md): Configure a company's document templates and render governed invoices, quotes and letters.
- [Group related expenses into a Batch](docs/users/how-to/group-expenses-into-a-batch.md): Select the expenses that belong together and add them to a proposed Batch so they share one business context.
- [Investigate a report value](docs/users/how-to/investigate-report-value.md): Trace a figure on a financial report back to the journal items and source documents behind it.
- [Manage bank matching rules](docs/users/how-to/manage-bank-matching-rules.md): Create, order and test the rules that propose counterparts for bank transactions.
- [Match a bank transaction](docs/users/how-to/reconcile-bank-transaction.md): Match a bank line against invoices, bills, expenses or a suggested counterpart.
- [Match a foreign bill to a company-currency bank transaction](docs/users/how-to/settle-immediate-foreign-payment.md): Settle a foreign-currency bill paid by card from the EUR debit the bank reports.
- [Prepare a French declaration](docs/users/how-to/prepare-declaration.md): Open the next obligation, compare ledger values with external confirmations and record the filing.
- [Prepare electronic-invoice reception](docs/users/how-to/prepare-electronic-invoice-reception.md): Get the company, partners and approved platform ready before reception is activated.
- [Process a supplier bill](docs/users/how-to/process-vendor-bill.md): Record a bill from its document, check lines and taxes, post it and match the payment.
- [Process an expense](docs/users/how-to/process-expense.md): Capture a receipt, complete the expense, submit it and follow it to reimbursement.
- [Process content-platform payouts](docs/users/how-to/process-platform-payouts.md): Import a platform payout, generate its invoices and bills, and settle it against the bank.
- [Provide read-only accountant access](docs/users/how-to/provide-accountant-access.md): Give an external accountant the Accountant Reviewer role on the right companies only.
- [Préparer et suivre une signature électronique](docs/users/how-to/signatures-electroniques.md): Préparer le document, désigner les signataires, suivre la signature et conserver la preuve.
- [Reconcile a clearing or other account](docs/users/how-to/reconcile-clearing-account.md): Settle balances on a non-bank account from the general reconciliation workspace.
- [Regrouper et contrôler des dépenses dans un lot](docs/users/how-to/expense-batches.md): Créer ou choisir un lot, appliquer le contexte commun, contrôler les lignes signalées et soumettre ensemble.
- [Review Accounting Hygiene](docs/users/how-to/review-accounting-hygiene.md): Work through the deterministic recommendations, open their records and confirm resolution.
- [Review an incoming electronic invoice](docs/users/how-to/review-incoming-electronic-invoice.md): Check a received e-invoice, accept it as a bill or reject it with a reason.
- [Review B2C commerce history](docs/users/how-to/review-b2c-commerce.md): Browse orders, events and settlements imported from the sales channels and open their accounting.
- [Run a monthly review](docs/users/how-to/run-monthly-review.md): Clear queues, check hygiene, reconcile, review reports and prepare the closing in one pass.
- [Send product feedback](docs/users/how-to/send-product-feedback.md): Report a bug, suggest an improvement or ask a question from any page and follow the answer.
- [Sign in with Pocket ID](docs/users/how-to/sign-in-with-pocket-id.md): Sign in to Odoo and Documents with a passkey through Pocket ID, and recover when it fails.
- [Traiter les encaissements des plateformes de contenu](docs/users/how-to/traiter-encaissements-plateformes.md): Importer un versement de plateforme, générer les factures et le rapprocher de la banque.
- [Try the Documents application](docs/users/how-to/test-paperless-documents.md): Review the Paperless-backed Documents experience on a test database before relying on it.

- [French declarations](docs/users/reference/declarations.md): The obligations the Declarations workspace tracks and where each figure comes from.
